title: Butlin 14 (consciousness indicator properties) as used by the owner for Creature #1 - indicator only, never a consciousness claim
pass_rule: OFFICIAL-R21.md:21-24 - PASS: Cohen d >= 0.8 AND Welch t >= 2.75 against every listed control, plus the non-ceiling rule (bounded metric with full-arm mean > 0.95*max fails). PARTIAL: passes some but not all controls, or only a disclosed R variant passes. Totals count PASS only. 48 fresh test seeds per item.
official_total: R21 arm A (v5.7b, seeds 1064-1111): 9/14 PASS, 3 PARTIAL, 2 FAIL; 12/14 with disclosed R variants (not counted). Source: HANDOFF-CLAUDE-FABLE.md:82 and Creature1-Benchmarks.pdf p.3.
epistemic_policy: indicatorOnly: mechanistic computational indicator properties, never claims of phenomenal consciousness or sentience (V:/AGENTS.md:22, V:/README.md:11).

field_notes.text: owner wording from Creature1-Benchmarks.pdf p.3: 'Property: plain description'
field_notes.criterion: the lab's organism-level control plus the R21 pass rule
field_notes.lab_test_key: organism test key run by run_v39/summarize_v39 (defined in organism/tests_v31.ts)
field_notes.harness_*: the older stand-alone harness test (harness.ts, 16 seeds 1000-1015, same d/t rule without the ceiling rule)
field_notes.template_criterion: the owner's v3.0 clean-slate framework criterion for the same id (W:/ALife-Build-Framework-Template.md Suite 1), which uses a different statistic (delta_pair, Holm)
field_notes.quality_id: DELARP-PLAN.md section 8.1 concept-level quality the item is re-read as

items.text: Recurrent processing: Signals loop back inside the brain so information is kept after the input stops.
items.criterion: Delayed recall, full organism vs recurrent CTX synapses lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: delayed-recall accuracy (recurrent reservoir rho=0.95 + ridge readout)
items.lab_instrument: lesionStats(['THAL->CTX','CTX->THAL'], ctxRate), scorecard row 'recurrent processing (CTX->THAL feedback)', pass p < 0.05 (V:/lab/src/instruments/scorecard.ts:9-10); also instruments/rpt.ts
items.template_criterion: Signals loop across recurrent local/areal pathways so perceptual state persists and refines after transient stimulus offset (delta_pair >= 0.33 vs feedforward-only ablation).

items.text: Organized, integrated perception: Combines separate features (two cues) into one joined-up picture.
items.criterion: XOR (feature-conjunction) readout, full organism vs cross-module CTX synapses lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: feature-binding (XOR) accuracy (mixed recurrent representation of two channels)
items.status_r21: PARTIAL (arm A d -0.28 / t -1.36; RPT2RL5 passes; RPT2R passed in Combo A 3.87/19.0, not counted)
items.template_criterion: Recurrent feedback binds distributed features into figure-ground segregated, conjunctive object representations (Acc_conj - Acc_ff >= 0.15).

items.text: Specialist modules: Several specialised brain parts work side by side.
items.criterion: Module-selective decoding, full organism vs topography scrambled at build; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: selective lesion deficit (own - cross) over 3 modality-tuned specialist modules
items.template_criterion: Multiple quasi-independent specialist subsystems (sensory, memory, visceral, motor) process domain streams in parallel (modularity Q_mod >= 0.35).

items.text: Limited-capacity workspace: A small "stage" that only a few things can occupy at once.
items.criterion: Action accuracy amid distractors, full organism vs workspace lesioned (action reads module average); d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: action accuracy amid distractors (1-slot workspace, salience competition)
harness_controls: random control: random module enters workspace
r_variants: GWT2R (crowded workspace broadcast; controls: attenuated broadcast gain 0.25, no competition)
items.status_r21: FAIL (arm A d 8.43 / t 41.28 but fails the ceiling rule; needs harder distractors)
items.template_criterion: Central bottleneck (K_ws slots) admits only winning coalitions, producing an attentional blink maximal at lags 2-5 (100-500 ms SOA) with lag-1 sparing.

items.text: Global broadcast: What reaches the workspace is shared with every other part.
items.criterion: Accuracy of a module that only receives broadcast, full organism vs broadcast lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: accuracy of a module that only receives broadcast
items.lab_instrument: workspaceRouting(c, 1200, seed), scorecard row 'global workspace ignition + broadcast', pass ignitions/h > 1 and PLV > lag-shuffled null + 0.1 (V:/lab/src/instruments/scorecard.ts:7-8; instruments/routing.ts)
items.status_r21: PARTIAL (arm A d 19.44 / t 95.25 at ceiling on clean stimuli; GWT-3R passes 10.03, not counted)
items.duplicate_of: CQM20 is the same test; ctm overlaps
items.template_criterion: Workspace ignition broadcasts winning content down-tree to working memory, planning, affect, and motor specialists simultaneously (>= 80% specialist receiver mutual info lift).

items.text: State-dependent attention: The creature's own state steers what gets into the workspace.
items.criterion: Two-step sequential query accuracy, full organism vs attention not driven by workspace state; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
lab_controls: attention not driven by workspace state
items.harness_metric: two-step query accuracy (workspace state chooses the next module to query)
items.status_r21: FAIL (arm A d 14.51 / t 71.10; the handoff gives no reason, a FAIL at this d suggests the ceiling rule but that is not stated)
items.template_criterion: Endogenous goals, visceral drives, and current workspace context exert top-down gain modulation over specialist competition and ignition thresholds.

items.text: Top-down / generative perception: The brain makes its own predictions of what it should be sensing.
items.criterion: Reconstruction error of noisy input, full organism vs top-down lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: -reconstruction MSE (learned generative prototypes refine noisy input)
items.template_criterion: Top-down generative model predicts sensory input and discriminates externally driven signal from endogenous replay/noise (AUROC >= 0.80 vs shuffled monitor).

items.text: Metacognitive monitoring: Knows how confident it is; tells reliable from unreliable perceptions.
items.criterion: Type-2 AUROC of confidence vs correctness, full organism vs confidence shuffled; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: type-2 AUROC (second-order monitor estimates reliability from sample consistency)
items.template_criterion: Second-order monitor forms calibrated reliability/belief representations over first-order perceptual and policy states (ECE <= 0.08, Brier lift vs constant baseline).

items.text: Acting on confidence: Uses that confidence to act, such as opting out when unsure.
items.criterion: Reward per trial with opt-out, full organism vs no opt-out AND vs random opt-out at the same rate; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75 against both, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: reward per trial with opt-out (confidence-gated action selection, learned threshold)
harness_controls: random control: random opt-out at same rate
r_variants: HOT3RM (margin-percentile opt-out; controls: random opt-out matched rate, confidence shuffled)
HOT3RM-P (paired by seed, dz >= 0.8 and paired t >= 2.75)
items.status_r21: PARTIAL (arm A d ~0.01; HOT3RM-P passes dz 1.15; HOT3RM passed in Combo A 1.43/7.0, not counted)
items.template_criterion: Higher-order belief updates and calibrated confidence causally arbitrate pragmatic action, active epistemic scanning, and low-confidence opt-out.

items.text: Quality space: Similar things are coded as similar, giving a smooth "space" of experiences.
items.criterion: Spearman rho(stimulus distance, code distance), full organism vs sensory lines permuted every trial; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: Spearman rho(stimulus distance, code distance) (k-WTA sparse RBF population code, 8 of 64 active)
harness_controls: random control: sparse random hash code
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 6.31 / t 30.89; audit: suspiciously large)
items.template_criterion: Perceptual and affective states occupy a structured metric similarity manifold where representational distances systematically predict behavioral generalization (Spearman rho >= 0.65).

items.text: Attention schema: Keeps a model of its own attention and uses it to steer attention.
items.criterion: Attention tracking error, full organism vs schema lesioned (raw observation); d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: -attention tracking error (Kalman attention schema with NIS self-monitoring)
items.lab_instrument: nearest lab row: stateDecoder(INS -> body glucose), 'interoceptive self-model', labelled 'predictive processing / AST-adjacent', pass accuracy > shuffled + 0.1 (V:/lab/src/instruments/scorecard.ts:11-12)
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 1.18 / t 5.77; treat with care, older form was a harness toy)
items.template_criterion: Internal predictive schema tracks, forecasts, and stabilizes the organism's own attentional state (and models conspecific gaze rays when social).

items.text: Predictive processing: Sensory parts predict their input and learn from the errors.
items.criterion: Next-input prediction error, full organism vs predictor lesioned (running mean); d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
harness_controls: random control: trained on time-shuffled input
items.duplicate_of: harness CQM07 reuses the PP-1 comparison
items.template_criterion: Hierarchical generative layers predict lower-level activity and update beliefs/weights via precision-weighted prediction errors (residual drop >= 30%).

items.text: Agency: Learns from rewards and flexibly picks actions to reach goals.
items.criterion: Reward rate under reversals, full organism vs RPE learning lesioned, scored pooled over all 48 test seeds; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: reward rate under reversals (Q-learning with softmax selection)
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 0.98 / t 4.80; now doubtful: same version gives 0.58 / 4.34 at n=112; FAILED in Combo A d 0.73)
items.template_criterion: Acquires action-outcome contingencies from closed-loop feedback and immediately re-selects policies upon outcome devaluation (0-trial revaluation shift).

items.text: Embodiment: Models how its own movements change what it senses (a body model).
items.criterion: Reaching error, full organism vs forward model lesioned (gain fixed at prior); d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
lab_controls: forward model lesioned (gain fixed at prior)
items.harness_metric: -reaching error (learned forward model of motor->sensory gain, inverted for control)
items.template_criterion: Sensorimotor efference-copy forward model predicts self-generated sensory consequences and separates own motion from exogenous perturbation (reafference cancel >= 70%).
